newsitem.title: USA: United Tech mulling more Asian staffing.
newsitem.headline: United Tech mulling more Asian staffing.

text.p: United Technologies Corp. is deciding whether to base some of its top managers in Asia, a spokesman said on Thursday.

"UTC has been taking a hard look at corporate staffing requirements for Asia," company spokesman Marty Moore told Reuters. "The specific details for meeting those requirements will of course be discussed first with UTC employees."

He was responding to a report in the Hartford Courant on Thursday which quoted United Technologies president and chief executive George David saying he may spend three months a year in Asia and shift other top managers there to stay.
David made the comments in Indonesia during an interview with a news agency.
The company's products include Carrier air conditioners, Otis elevators, Pratt & Whitney jet engines and Sikorsky helicopters.
